scripts.dev:workspaces: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names packages,web "tsc -b packages/contracts packages/domain packages/resume-engine packages/ui --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev --workspace @candidate/web"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:release
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @candidate/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @candidate/extension
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && node --test packages/domain/src/operation-progress.test.ts packages/domain/src/candidate-profile.test.ts packages/domain/src/resume-production.test.ts packages/domain/src/workflow.test.ts packages/domain/src/history.test.ts packages/domain/src/processing-reports.test.ts && npm test --workspace @candidate/web && npm test --workspace @candidate/extension
scripts.build:packages: node packages/contracts/scripts/compile-resume-schema.mjs --check && tsc -b packages/contracts packages/domain packages/resume-engine packages/ui
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @candidate/web && npm run build --workspace @candidate/extension
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @candidate/web
scripts.extension:build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @candidate/extension
scripts.feasibility:pdf: npm run build:packages && npm run feasibility:pdf --workspace @candidate/extension
